abstract: Germ cell tumors usually present with symptoms that are attributed to their location. This article describes a patient who had an extragonadal tumor that was not discovered until he experienced several tumor-related complications.
abstract_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍は通常、その発生部位に起因する症状で発見される。本稿では、性腺外に生じた腫瘍が、腫瘍関連の合併症が出現するまで発見されなかった患者を報告する。
